response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgb, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avgb) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, SUM(cnt) AS telescope_count, SUM(cnt) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(cnt)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage
